verified_facts.text: Located directly in Dresden's historic city centre, the Innere Altstadt, a few steps from sights such as the Semper Opera House, Royal Palace, Zwinger and Frauenkirche.

verified_facts.text: The Semperoper is a two-minute stroll (200 metres) from the hotel across Theaterplatz.

verified_facts.text: August the Great built the Taschenberg Palace for his mistress, Anna Constantia.

verified_facts.text: The hotel welcomes dogs exclusively; other pets cannot be accommodated.
verified_facts.excerpt: To cater to the needs of our four-legged guests, we welcome dogs exclusively.

verified_facts.text: Dogs receive a dog bed, blanket, feeding bowl and snacks, and there is an a la Carte Dog Menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: a dog bed and a cosy blanket, a shiny new feeding bowl, exciting walks, a selection of little snacks and titbits and, of course, the à la Carte Dog Menu

verified_facts.text: Les Clefs d'Or concierges can assist with ticket reservations, private tours and recommendations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Let our Les Clefs d’Or concierges assist with ticket reservations, private tours and insider recommendations.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has one charging station for Tesla vehicles and two for electric cars.

verified_facts.text: Pre-theatre dinner can be had at Das Palais or Kastenmeiers.
verified_facts.excerpt: an exquisite pre-theatre dinner at Das Palais or Kastenmeiers.

verified_facts.text: Dresden International Airport is about 10.7 km from the hotel, around 20 to 30 minutes by car depending on traffic.

verified_facts.text: The closest public transport stop is Postplatz, served by several tram lines and two bus lines.
verified_facts.excerpt: The closest stops to Hotel Taschenbergpalais Kempinski is "Postplatz" (Tram lines 1, 2, 4, 8, 9, 11, 12; Busses 62, 94).

verified_facts.text: The concierge can arrange out-of-hours tours of the Green Vault as part of the GHA Experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: our concierge can arrange out-of-hours tours of the Green Vault as part of the GHA Experience.

verified_facts.text: Moritzburg Castle is about a 20-minute drive from the hotel.
